def resid(p):
    w,k,ph,G=p
    f=np.cos(w*t+k*x+ph)*(1+G*x)
    A=np.column_stack([poly,f,np.sin(w*t+k*x+ph)*(1+G*x)])
    cc,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)
    return y-A@cc
